'''Waveflutter''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Ripplewing]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Morphanessa]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Waveflutter is devoted to elegance and always maintains perfect posture. Flies high to seek clean water vapor, and also to stay as far as possible from the dirty bunch on the ground."

Waveflutter is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

==Evolution Trial==
Waveflutter's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Morphanessa]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

*Feed this Tatari to B quality.
*Play [[Fishing Contest]] (Use Fishing Rod x6,000) or [[Zobo Shooter]] (Use Bullet Coin x600,000).
*Own 5 Water [[Badge Dojo|Badges]].

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "The shiny powder from Waveflutter's wings will make fish jump in your boat while you're fishing."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Moving with the grace of a ballet dancer, Waveflutter is hailed as one of the finest Tatari dancers. The dance controls water flows and can even conjure enchanting waterfalls."
